context: Mei and Aoi plan an evening at the theater.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: leisure chat; vocabulary (劇場/開か/かける/ティー/おっしゃる) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今夜、劇場でお芝居を観るの。
lines.en: Tonight I'll see a play at the theater.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle excited delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね!何時に開かれるの?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 七時に、幕が開かれるの。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: チケットに、お金かけたんでしょ?
lines.en: You spent money on the ticket, right?
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、良い席にかけちゃった。
lines.en: Yeah, I splurged on a good seat.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 前に観た俳優、何ておっしゃってた?
lines.en: What did the actor you saw before say?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 「また劇場で」と、おっしゃってたわ。
lines.en: He said 'see you at the theater again.'
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 帰りに、ミルクティー飲もうね!
lines.en: On the way back, let's have milk tea!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
